commands: execute if entity @e[type=palladium:custom_projectile,distance=..10,tag=powerborne.stormbreaker_projectile] run scoreboard players set @s powerborne.stormbreaker_projectile_distance 1
execute if entity @e[type=palladium:custom_projectile,distance=..10,tag=powerborne.stormbreaker_projectile] run damage @s 1 minecraft:generic

insert_power_stone.title: Insert Power Stone
commands: execute if entity @s[palladium.power=!infinity:power_stone_passive] run superpower add infinity:power_stone_passive @s
execute if entity @s[palladium.power=!infinity:power_stone_passive] run scoreboard players set @s power_stone 1
execute if entity @s[palladium.power=!infinity:power_stone_passive] run playsound infinity:infinity_stone_equip block @s
execute if entity @s[palladium.power=!infinity:power_stone_passive] run tag @s add insert_anim
execute if entity @s[palladium.power=!infinity:power_stone_passive] run schedule function infinity:remove_insert_anim 20t
execute if entity @s[palladium.power=!infinity:power_stone_passive] run particle dust_color_transition 1 0 1 5 1 1 1 ~ ~1 ~ 1.5 1.5 1.5 0 50 force

remove_power_stone.title: Remove Power Stone
commands: execute as @s run superpower remove infinity:power_stone_passive @s
